source.lapis_dirty_scope: Supervisor state v2, daemon reconstruction, tests, documentation and this receipt.

scope: Daemon restart reconstruction for one persisted live session. No GUI/CLI route, launchd, package update, reboot, reset protocol or multi-session behavior is added.

implementation.state_schema: Version 2 persists canonical agent program, literal arguments, working directory, geometry and integration mode. Version 1 sessions remain decodable but cannot reconstruct and fail closed.
implementation.startup: A replacement daemon rebuilds SessionServiceLauncher from persisted v2 state and converges before binding its control endpoint.
implementation.admission: Reconstruction rejects another birth and preserves the existing one-session slot.

review_repairs: Version-one state rejects launch data while retaining started-session enablement and token invariants.
The daemon restart test keeps the stale control endpoint in place, tracks both daemon PIDs for failure cleanup, and clears each PID after reaping it.
Earlier architecture text is explicitly historical and the state-core status row now names v1/v2 persistence.
Daemon startup timeout diagnostics include elapsed milliseconds, and failure cleanup waits for the killed service and terminal child.
Persisted geometry comes from the validated launch, and failure cleanup signals individual service/terminal PIDs before bounded disappearance checks.
observed: SIGKILL of the daemon left the real service and terminal child alive.
The service ownership bytes and PID survived daemon death.
A replacement daemon using the same state directory adopted that exact service.
The reconnected v6 client saw the same terminal child and session identity and could still exercise terminal input.
Explicit replacement-daemon stop removed service ownership and left version-2 private stopped state.

validation.name: focused-supervisor-reconstruction
validation.result: All four focused CTest suites passed, including the daemon SIGKILL/reconstruction case and observed service/daemon integration markers.

validation.name: repository-quality
validation.result: Repository contracts, Ruff and Python unit tests passed.

non_claims: No GUI/CLI production birth client, launchd registration, package inclusion, upgrade or reboot qualification is claimed.
No persisted-v1-session migration/reset protocol is implemented.
No credential-environment admission, real Codex/Claude launch, load, memory, latency or idle-CPU measurement is claimed.
